items.headline: Albemarle Stock Slides 28% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand CAGR of 10-20% from 2025-2030, growth trending near high end of 15-40% range this year. Salar yield improvement project in Chile at 50-60% operating rate. CGP3 expansion at Greenbushes expected full production Q1 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. Raising 2026/2030 stationary storage forecast ranges. Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth; exited Q2 near record lows in days of lithium salt inventory.
